item.title: Iran's war against the US and Israel is being fueled by North Korean weapons, expert warns
item.summary: Iran's ballistic missiles, including the Shahab-3 and Khorramshahr-4, were developed with North Korean help, says expert Bruce Bechtol, who urges stronger sanctions enforcement.

item.title: AI war in Iran has brought conflict to Silicon Valley. No one is ready
item.summary: Iran published a 29-location target list naming Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Nvidia and Palantir, then struck AWS data centers in the UAE and Bahrain.

item.title: Insurgent Virginia Democrat says his party is ‘completely wrong’ on gun rights and gerrymandering
item.summary: Democratic primary challenger Mark Moran says his party is "completely wrong" on gun rights, sparking backlash from Virginia Democrats over his Second Amendment stance.

item.title: Gavin Newsom bashes Elon Musk as ‘one of the great disappointments'
item.summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom told Axios that Elon Musk has “put the brakes" on EV innovation and warned China is overtaking the United States in the electric vehicle market.

item.title: Communists, Democrats use #NoKings rally to call for May Day strike: 'Shut it down'
item.summary: Communists chanted for revolution and May Day strikes from New York to Minnesota, as the "No Kings" movement sees a growing ideological shift to more radical rhetoric

item.title: Pirates broadcasters slam Oneil Cruz's defensive effort vs Mets
item.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates outfielder Oneil Cruz faced criticism from broadcasters on Sunday as he glided to a fly ball against the New York Mets on Sunday.

item.title: Mark Cuban credits his 'disgusting' sandwich for helping him boost protein and beat aging
item.summary: Entrepreneur Mark Cuban admits his go-to lunch of canned baby clams, egg white wraps, and honey is "disgusting" but says it fuels his protein and longevity goals.

item.title: Charles Barkley tees off on alleged treatment of 'amazing immigrants'
item.summary: NBA legend Charles Barkley went on a rant on Sunday about how "amazing immigrants" are treated in the U.S. without citing examples of such treatment.

item.title: LSU infielder tosses bat sky-high after clutch home run in comeback win
item.summary: LSU Tigers infielder Seth Dardar hit a clutch home run in the bottom of the sixth inning to help the team regain the lead and eventually win against Kentucky.
